name: Put domoy
source:
Before it all began, there were hundreds and thousands of copies trying to escape the confines of Sovyonok. But they were nothing more than shadows, disappearing at the first rays of the sun. Is there even a need to talk about their motivation?

When you have experienced everything there is in the camp, only one thought keeps you afloat: "Is there a way out of here?" Right now, one of these shadows has made it so far that it can already smell freedom. All that remains is to find out if it will disappear when the sun reaches its zenith.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1507788339]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这一切开始之前，已有成百上千的副本试图逃离Sovyonok的限制。但它们不过是影子，在第一缕阳光下就消失了。还需要谈论他们的动机吗？

当你经历了营地里的一切之后，只有一个念头让你保持清醒：“有办法离开这里吗？”现在，其中一个影子已经走出了那么远，已经闻到了自由的味道。剩下的就是弄清楚当太阳到达最高点时它是否会消失。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1507788339]Steam[/url]]
